summary: Describes the generated background for Stability's asynchronous Replace Background and Relight endpoint. It can describe the scene, the desired lighting, or both, and accepts up to 10,000 characters.
combines: This field belongs to the direct Stability v2beta Replace Background and Relight endpoint and is not part of the Bedrock Stable Image model request.
The request must include subject_image plus background_prompt, background_reference, or both.
Supporting this field requires a separate asynchronous edit operation and result-polling path, so it remains absent pending implementation investigation.
note: This belongs to a separate asynchronous Replace Background and Relight operation. It is not a generation-row control and remains unimplemented.
